$comment: The console page region contract. Per page type: the regions in drawing order, the one part that fills each, the page.blocks slot that feeds it, the DOM marks (data-slot or data-part) that place a control in it, and the control kinds it may hold. Agents read it before composing a page; scripts/check-regions.mjs enforces it on the kit source and scripts/regions-rendered.mjs on a rendered page.

notices.$comment: maxControls counts labelled actions; the card's own icon-only dismiss is the part's.

timeRange.$comment: Off unless a blocks file switches it on with data; the template draws the strip.

toolbar.$comment: crud-filter-bar-chip-remove is the remove button inside each active filter chip. crud-filter-bar-view-button is the list/grid switch of a list that offers both presentations (RecordList viewToggle); it stands in the filter bar's leading group or, on a list with no filters, in the record list toolbar.

cell.$comment: A cell shows a value; a reference to another record is a link and is the value itself, every other control is refused. A list drawn as cards (RecordList presentation cards, or the table below its card breakpoint) holds the same values in the card's title row and body, so those are the cell region's marks too; a card's row action strip stays in rowActions because the button reaches that mark first.

pagination.$comment: countFollowsData: one page button per page the rows fill, so a rendered comparison with a frame compares the kinds drawn here and not their count.

body.$comment: Free content: forms, tables and cards the type's body holds; any control may sit here, never a region part.

authNotices.$comment: The banners a sign-in step opens with; a banner may carry its own close control.

preferences.$comment: Language and theme, drawn by the layout on every page before a session; no screen fills it.

recordHead.part: The opened record's head (title, status, close)
recordHead.$comment: The framework's detail header, drawn on the drawer, the panel and the dialog alike: it holds the record's title, status, view switch and close. The view switch is the recordView region, nearer, so what the head holds is the close. A control standing in no region is unassigned on every surface.

recordView.$comment: Panel, drawer, dialog, full page and the view settings, drawn by the record head on every record.

recordBody.$comment: Free content: sections, fields, tables and the controls their values carry (copy, peek, a tab's own list).

list-detail.$comment: rows open a detail, so every row with rows on screen carries the action strip; a tab whose panel is free content instead of the list (a settings group's form, a change table) draws it in the body region, which holds any control

record-detail.$comment: The record a list row opens, read on the surface it stands on: the drawer (the sheet's part), the panel beside the list or the dialog. A list-detail page is read twice, the list under `main` and the opened record under this root, so the record's signature is never the list's.

valueParts.$comment: Files that draw a value (a list cell or a detail value). A value part draws no control: a row's verbs live in its action strip, copy and the whole text in the detail.

slotProps.$comment: Interfaces a page fills its slots through. Every boolean prop in them is listed here with the reason it changes content (a region on or off, behaviour) rather than look; an unlisted boolean is a per-screen presentation flag and fails the check.

flags.RecordColumn.wrap: a column whose values are prose wraps instead of truncating; decided by the value, not by the screen's look
flags.RecordColumn.sortable: behaviour: whether the server sorts by the column
flags.RecordColumn.cardKeep: content: the column stays on the card presentation because the card is unreadable without it
flags.RecordColumn.keep: content: the column stays in the table at every width because another drawn column reads wrong without it; decided by the content, not by the screen's look
flags.RecordListFeatures.search: turns the search region on or off
flags.RecordListFeatures.filters: turns the filter region on or off
flags.RecordListFeatures.chips: turns the chip filters on or off
flags.RecordListFeatures.rowActions: turns the row action strip on or off
flags.RecordListFeatures.count: turns the count on or off
flags.RecordListProps.viewToggle: content: offers a table list the switch to the cards where the screen's design entry says its rows are also read as units; a cards list always has the switch
flags.RecordListProps.keyboard: behaviour: gives the page's keys to this list
flags.PageTabSpec.when: whether the tab exists for this reader
flags.PageTabSpec.unbuilt: content: the tab names a capability the server does not offer yet
flags.PageSpec.tilesLoading: state: the figures are still loading
flags.PageSpec.tabClosesRecord: behaviour: switching the tab closes the open record
flags.PageSpec.tilesCollapsible: behaviour: whether the figure row folds; a page whose figures are what it is for (a dashboard) keeps them open with no fold control

dataSlots.$comment: Region members a page fills with data only. A member whose type names ReactNode lets a screen draw the region by hand and fails the check.

partTokens.$comment: What a framework part drawn inside the kit must equal: each property of the part's element against the theme token the framework's own styles name for it. scripts/regions-rendered.mjs probeTokens/compareTokens measure it.

timeRange.$comment: every slice is a step of the theme ramp from muted (empty) to primary (busiest)

pageApi.$comment: Every member of a page type's spec or blocks interface that takes a drawn node, with its class: body (the type's one free content area), content (free composition inside a named slot the template draws, never a region part), or dialogs. A node-typed member not listed here lets a screen draw a region by hand, and check-regions fails it.

PageHelpSpec.render.reason: the explanation inside the help card the page draws

PageNoticeSpec.children.reason: the text a notice card explains, inside the card the page draws

PageSpec.actions.reason: the header's verbs (PageAction, ExportAction) inside the actions region the header draws

PageSpec.phone.reason: the content area a phone draws instead

CrudPageBlocks.headerActions.reason: header verbs that read the list, inside the actions region

app-shell.ShellMenuEntry.inactiveMark.reason: a menu entry's mark for an unbuilt destination

app-shell.ShellParts.brand.reason: the product mark and badge inside the shell's brand slot

app-shell.ShellParts.phoneFooter.reason: what a phone draws under the menu

app-shell.ShellParts.wrap.reason: the providers the routed screens need, wrapping the shell

app-shell.top-bar.ShellParts.topBar.reason: the band's mark, destinations and controls, inside the top bar region the shell draws

app-shell.top-bar.ShellParts.wrap.reason: the providers the routed screens need
